other_conditions: Must be confirmed as suffering from silicosis by the Silicosis Diagnosis Board, Haryana
Must be registered with the Haryana Silicosis Board
Must be employed in a factory or at a construction site
If the worker dies before receiving assistance, the benefit is payable to the widow/widower if married, or to one of the living parents if unmarried
benefits_summary: One-time assistance of ₹5,00,000 is provided to silicosis‑affected workers, or to their widow/widower or parents if the worker dies before receiving the amount.
